description: Replacement of flat roof with pitched roof to existing rear outbuilding
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing dwellinghouse.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (SSB/51/2020 received 22/11/2019 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those incidental to the application property and shall not be used as primary accommodation such as a living room, bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, study or as a separate unit of accommodation.
Reason- The accommodation is considered unsuitable for occupation by a separate person or household and such use would have a detrimental effect upon the character of the neighbourhood and the residential amenity of surrounding occupiers. To accord with policies SC1, SC4, SC5, SC7 and CC2 of the adopted Local Plan
